title_as_printed: Experimental values of Ps/Pw, and calculated values of cp,s/cp,w and Cp,phi for NaCl solutions at other pressures

footnotes_as_printed.a: p is the pressure of the experiment.
footnotes_as_printed.b: rho_s/rho_w is the ratio of the density of the solution to the density of water at 298.15 K and p. (refs 12, 13)
footnotes_as_printed.c: T is the initial temperature of the experiment. In all experiments DeltaT calculated from the power input, the heat capacity of water, and the heat losses (f) is (2+/-0.2) K.

pressure_note: flow calorimeter; pressure of the experiment printed in each block label (1.0 MPa at 320.55 K, 10 MPa at 572.14 K)

T.note: initial temperature; temperature rise (2+/-0.2) K (footnote c)

value.what: apparent molar heat capacity of NaCl from cp,s/cp,w via eq (4)

value2.what: ratio of specific heat capacity of solution to water at T and p, eq (6)

value3.what: measured heater power ratio, solution to water (primary measured quantity)

value4.what: density ratio solution/water at 298.15 K and p, from the literature equations (Fine and Millero; Chen, Emmet and Millero) used in eq (6)

skip_rows.reason: temperature/pressure label rows (also carried by group_rows)

notes: Footnotes c (on T) and a (on p) are printed in the first block label only; recorded as note T:c;p:a. Row 10 (572.14 K, 3.0000 mol/kg) cp,s/cp,w is printed 0.07330, an evident misprint: recomputing eq (6) from the printed Ps/Pw, f = 1.05 and rho_s/rho_w gives 0.70330, which also reproduces the printed Cp,phi -328.82; kept as printed. Row 6 (572.14 K, 0.0996 mol/kg): the printed ratio 0.97925 equals 1 + f(Ps/Pw - 1) without the density division; the printed Cp,phi -1084.15 corresponds to the density-corrected ratio 0.97534. Kept as printed; flagged.
